column1: # --- town: Hunter's shoppe, armory, guest house, market (talk window)

column4: Welcome to the hunter's shoppe! We offer all kinds of goods to match your Hunter Rank!\n...What can I get for you?
Oh, it's you! I see you've been working hard to raise your HR.
So, as a special treat, I'm revealing our secret monster info! Put it to good use against unknown wyverns, and in your Monster Records!
Huh? You don't know about Monster Records? That's when you log a monster's length in your Monster List. Every hunter knows that!
As a special treat, we've got charms with amazing effects! And info on the monsters everyone's talking about. Use it well!
Um... excuse me? I heard you drove off Lao-Shan Lung twice. You're joking, right?
Buy it together with the Storage Expert book that's already a hit, and your storage goes up by a whole 200! You just have to buy it, right?
Welcome to the armory. We offer all kinds of equipment to match your Hunter Rank.\nWhat can I get for you?
Congratulations on slaying the Gypceros!
Under Guild rules, you may now buy Silver Metal Boots.
Boots made of a special alloy. They're sure to serve you well. Please, try them!
Good work slaying the Rathalos!
Under Guild rules, you may now buy Dark Metal Boots and Pink Metal Boots.
Lovely new colors to put a little style in your step! Please, try them!
Congratulations on slaying two Diablos!
Under Guild rules, you may now buy the upgraded alloy boots.
A new offer from the Hunter's Guild, made with your legs' health in mind! Please, try them!
Splendid work repelling Lao-Shan Lung!
Under Guild rules, you may now buy Chrome Metal G Boots and Chrome Metal G Coil.
Black alloy set off by an elegant gold pattern. Perfect for the mature hunter, and the Guild's own pick! Please, try them!
Congratulations on slaying both Rathalos and Rathian!
Under Guild rules, you may now buy the strongest alloy boots.
It's all about the S! S for Super! Special!! Spectacular!!!
...Ahem. Er, let me start over.
Splendid work repelling Lao-Shan Lung!
Under Guild rules, you may now buy Chrome Metal S Boots and Chrome Metal S Coil.
Refined design. Refined Defense. You'll never want any other armor... Please, try them!
...*Gulp!* Oh, uh, welcome! Today's a big sales day! My shop's always well stocked, and today we've got loads of special goods! Don't miss out!
...*Gulp!* Oh, uh, welcome! Today's half-price day. If you buy too much I won't make a profit, so go easy on me!
Even at the Bishop Room level, we give fancy tickets to our regular customers.
Even at the Bishop Room level, we give fancy tickets to our regular customers.
I hear you drove off the giant dragon that attacked the fortress! I can smell the money from here!
For a customer like you, we can offer the Queen Room! Please, take your time and relax.
You drove off the giant dragon! Splendid! Please, make yourself at home in the Queen Room.
Well, well! Welcome! I hear you slew both Rathian and Rathalos!
You carry yourself like royalty, so we'd be honored to offer you rooms up to the King Room!
You carry yourself like royalty, so we'd be honored to offer you rooms up to the King Room! Please, enjoy your stay!
Come again anytime.
Come on, buy whatever you like! It's half-price day! Fresh food is a bargain, too!
Lucky you! We've got special goods today! Come on, buy whatever you like!
Come on in! Oh? You've got a hunter's eyes now! How can I tell? Remembering customers is the first rule of business!
I've got something nice for you! Take this to the armory!
Also, from here on, in the top-rank quests, the Guild can't promise you its full support.
Before you head out on one of those, be sure to hear the details from the Guildmaster.
By the way, if you buy Storage Expert, you can store 100 more items. It's a bit pricey, though.
The Master Craftsman Triplets' armory has an Item Box, too. Buy Storage Expert and you can store 100 more items!
The Elders at our armory were saying that it helps to have a Gunner with you when you fight a giant dragon.
They say a giant dragon's weak spot is on its back. A Gunner can hit it there more easily. Is that true?
They say giant dragons have a weak spot on the back, and a Gunner can hit it there more easily. Is that true?
I hear the G-rank monsters in top-rank quests give the very best materials.
With those materials, you can make gear more powerful than anything before!
To stand up to G-rank monsters, you'll need to power up your gear, of course.
I hear the G-rank monsters in top-rank quests give the very best materials.
To stand up to G-rank monsters, you'll need to power up your gear, of course.
You'll find Item Boxes in your Guest House room and at the armory.
But they won't always make the same trade, so be careful.
For example, you might trade them Iron Ore and get Sm Monster Bone or Mystery Bone back.
The Veggie Elders in the Forest and Hills, Swamp, and Jungle won't always make the same trade, so be careful.
For example, you might trade them Iron Ore and get Sm Monster Bone or Mystery Bone back.
Last time I visited the Elder in the Swamp, I think... he traded me something really good for a Vespoid Abdomen.
But be careful. The Veggie Elders won't always trade you the same thing.
Last time I visited the Elder in the Swamp, I think... he traded me something really good for a Vespoid Abdomen.
But be careful. The Veggie Elders won't always trade you the same thing.
He traded me Carbalite Ore for a Hornetaur Razorwing!
Oh, but the other day, he gave me Dragonite Ore for a Hornetaur Razorwing! I guess he's moody.
Oh, but the other day, he gave me Dragonite Ore for a Hornetaur Razorwing! I guess he's moody.
He traded me Albino Prime Cut for a Hellfire Stone!
Oh, but the other day, I gave him a Hellfire Stone and got a Gravios Carapace! I guess he's moody.
The Veggie Elders are really moody, but if you use them well, you can get lots of good deals. Good luck!
Fishing is fun, but nothing beats hunting.
The other day I was out enjoying a hunt in all sorts of places, when...
a Yian Kut-Ku in a strange color showed up! What a shock!
It's a bird every hunter knows, right? But... that color... Were my eyes playing tricks?
That strange-colored Kut-Ku I saw... Armor in that color would look lovely.
Or were my eyes playing tricks?
Press the L1 button to open or close the List of all players in town.
In the List, you can check other people's quest status and settings at a glance.
In the Player List, people on the same quest as you are shown in orange.
Use Edit Comment in the menu to write a comment about yourself.
That's just basic manners for a hunter, right?
Oh, and on half-price day, the combination shop does combination requests at half price, too.
When that happens, use the keyboard's Set Recipient feature.
You can send chat to just your quest members or to one friend.
When you chat only to your quest members, the text is green. When you chat to just one person, the text is yellow.
It's easy to set: the L2 button on the soft keyboard, or the Tab key on a USB keyboard. Give it a try!
I hear really huge monsters have been seen in what hunters call the top-rank quests.
Hunters seem to call them King Size.
Prey bigger than anything you've ever seen... I have a feeling something would happen if you hunted one!
King Size, only in top-rank quests... I have a feeling something would happen if you hunted one!
Fishing, cooking meat... I hear they teach you all the basics a hunter needs to know there.
They say hunting from the town is tougher than in the village, so maybe you should practice in the village first.
They say hunting from the town is tougher than in the village, so maybe you should practice in the village first.
I hear the kind Village Chief teaches you the hunting basics step by step.
A giant dragon!? If this hunter's story is true, we're in trouble!
I hear upgrading a melee weapon raises its Sharpness, up to five levels.
Rumor has it a sixth level of Sharpness appears some other way than upgrading. Is that true?
Upgrading a melee weapon raises its Sharpness up to five levels. Rumor says a sixth appears some other way. Is that true?
I hear some wyverns come in rare colors.
And it seems the key to meeting those monsters is hunting big monsters! Exciting news, huh?
To meet monsters in rare colors, you have to hunt big monsters. Pretty good tip, huh!?
You beat that giant dragon? For the third time!? Are you really that good a hunter?
Hey, how's it going? As a ticket maniac, I did some digging, and it looks like this inn gives out three kinds of tickets.
The Rook Room gives a Silver Ticket. The Bishop Room gives a Gold Ticket.
What's the last one? I'm doing my best to find out. ...Do you know?
Silver and Gold. I really want to know about that last ticket... ...Do you know?
What!? You beat it already?? ...Then let me sing! La la la♪ You're famous now♪ The hero of our town♪ I can't wait to see the hero fall♪
If you buy Storage Expert at the hunter's shoppe in the tavern...
your Item Box holds 100 more items! That's handy! The Storage Expert book is on my wish list, too!
The Storage Expert book: your Item Box holds 100 more. It's on my wish list, too!
I heard you're taking on top-rank quests. Out of respect for your hard work, I'll be honest with you...
I hear you're taking on top-rank quests. Out of respect for your hard work, let me confess... my big secret...
Hey! Welcome! Today's the day of the big sales event!
Everything in the market is half-price! Oh, wait! At the combination shop, it's requests that are half-price! Rob us blind!
Everything in the market is half-price today! Combination requests are half-price too! Go ahead, rob us blind!
Today's hunter tip: Sharpness. Upgrade your melee weapon and its Sharpness rises, and so does its power. Useful, huh?
Oh... What a mess. With the giant dragon back, I can't send a letter to my sister.
And I wrote to her about the top-rank Hunter Ranks, too...
In the top rank, I hear Hunter Rank goes all the way up to 30. But how many hunters can really stand up to G-rank monsters?
In the top rank, I hear Hunter Rank goes all the way up to 30. I wonder what gear you can make from G-rank monster materials?
When you fought that rocky giant dragon, I was nearby.
Master! I hear you can record how many monsters you've slain, and even their size, in the Monster List!!
Hunters call recording the size a Monster Record, it seems.
Measuring a monster like a prize fish! Can you believe anyone does that with such scary monsters?
Master, why don't you try it? A Monster Record. I hear you can start right away if you buy monster info.
I hear you can record how many monsters you've slain, and even their size, in the Monster List!!
I hear you can start right away if you buy monster info.
They say there's an Azure Rathalos!
And, and, they say there's a Pink Rathian, too!
Do you think it's true!? What do you think?
Master! The info I got from the Hell Brothers says there are monsters with different body colors!
An Azure Rathalos. A Pink Rathian. Can they really exist!?
Master!! I got more info from that weird pair, the Hell Brothers!
They say that in top-rank quests, there's sometimes a Yian Kut-Ku outbreak!
When you reach your limit, put the Felyne Cart Ticket from the supplies in the Delivery Box, and the quest counts as a success!
When there's a Kut-Ku outbreak, slay as many as you can, and when you hit your limit, deliver the Felyne Cart Ticket! Got it?
Master!! Driving off that giant dragon, the one like a rocky mountain... Honestly, you're invincible!
I heard you can get rare materials from that giant dragon's back...
If that's true, you could make gear unlike anything from the giant dragons before!
Driving off that giant dragon, the one like a rocky mountain... Master, you really are invincible!
Haven't seen you before. Did you come here to be a hunter, too?
All sorts of people live in this big town. Listen to what they say, and you'll pick up useful info.
I hear the materials from Lao-Shan Lung, like its Shell, Scale, Claw, Horn and Plate, make powerful gear! I'm so jealous!
A True Black Dragon Spear! Maybe you could make a weapon like that!?
A True Black Dragon Spear! Maybe you could make a weapon like that!?
Is it true? You slew that rocky giant dragon that attacked the fortress!?
It seems you need a material called Lao-Shan Ruby. They say it's very rare. Can anyone really get one?
It looks like you have good friends with you.
Tell me how you fought sometime, will you?
Kirin, cloaked in lightning, calls down thunder at will. Don't you want to see one, just once?
I still can't believe it. You've driven off Lao-Shan Lung again and again...
When we first met here, I never imagined you'd grow into such a great hunter...
Did you know some armor skill types are really unusual?
Torso Up doubles the skill points on your body armor.
Wear several, and your body armor's points go 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x!
Torso Plus adds points to the skill types on your body armor.
Both are great deals, so try them when you get body armor with good skill types!
Me, I recommend both Torso Up and Torso Plus!
That's what my papa says, and he's a top hunter who's slain lots of wyverns!
Have you heard of the skill type called Glutton?
I hear it gives you skills that help with Stamina!
Something about feeling fuller when you eat cooked meat and such... Papa told me. Is it true?
I hear the Glutton skill type gives you skills that help with Stamina. Papa told me... Is it true?
It's a skill that makes you take less damage than usual when you're hit! Was it called Divine Protection?
It doesn't always work, but it's reassuring! There sure are some strange skills.
The Divine Protection skill seems to reduce damage now and then.
You beat that rocky giant dragon!?
There's a skill called Sharpness +1. It's a special skill that adds one level to your Sharpness gauge.
But I don't really know which skill type activates it...
But I bet you can find out!
With the Sharpness +1 skill, you can add one level to your Sharpness gauge!
I don't know which skill type activates it... But I bet you can find out!
Do you know the secret of making Swords? Depending on how you make them, you can create Dual Swords, a pair of blades!
With no shield you can't guard, but you'd get in so many more hits...
And I heard pressing R1 lets you unleash a fierce attack for a while, until your Stamina runs out.
Wow, just thinking about it gets my heart racing!
Do you know the secret of making Swords? Depending on how you make them, you can create Dual Swords, a pair of blades!
Forest Elder: monster parts. Swamp Elder: ores. Jungle... I forget! Try it yourself.
Forest Elder: monster parts. Swamp Elder: ores. Jungle... I forget! Try it yourself.
You've slain Lao-Shan Lung twice, and you're aiming even higher.
Time to use my Platinum Ticket, saved over a year at the Guest House...!!
What I'm after is the Barbaroi Blade! How about it? Coolest name ever, right?
The Platinum Ticket I saved up from a whole year at the Guest House!
What I'm after is the Barbaroi Blade! How about it? Now you want one too, don't you?
Right now I'm dying to go on a top-rank quest!
In top-rank quests, supplies aren't guaranteed, and you might not even start from camp!
You can't get that kind of thrill anywhere else! I'm shaking with excitement!
What? Am I allowed to go on top-rank quests? Ouch, that hurts! Leave me alone!
In top-rank quests, supplies aren't guaranteed, and you might not even start from camp!
You can't get that kind of thrill anywhere else! I'm shaking with excitement!
I mean, I wouldn't fight Fatalis even if it killed me.
Now that the Black Dragon is gone, my life as a hunter is just beginning! Hunting rules!!
They say it's a different color from the giant dragons seen before. I'd have loved just one look at it!
But you're the one who really saved this town. Thanks! You did a great job!
Dohahaha! Top-rank quests sure are tough!
After all, there's no guarantee your supplies will arrive.
And they make you fight G-rank brutes like that! What a classy touch!
Well, this great Red Ogre plays it safe and always carries a Farcaster! Dohahaha!
Top-rank quests should keep me from getting bored until HE shows up! Dohahaha!
Diablos has its sneaky tricks, like charging at you with its two horns, but
Bahahaha! Top-rank quests sure are tough!
After all, they often drop you somewhere crazy and make you start the quest from there.
And they make you fight G-rank brutes like that! What a classy touch!
Well, this great Black Ogre plays it safe and always carries a Farcaster! Bahahaha!
Top-rank quests should keep me from getting bored until HE shows up! Bahahaha!
Honestly, this boy! I keep telling him to pick the Alchemy skill, study combining more deeply, and hunt smarter!
A modern man should use the Alchemy skill to study combining more deeply and hunt smarter, right!?
Do you know the Guard +1 skill?
I hear it shortens the opening after you guard! Though with some attacks, it seems to make no difference.
With the Guard +1 skill, I hear the opening after you guard can be shorter! If you hear anything useful, please tell me!
The Razor Sharp skill! It makes Sharpness last longer! With that, you could just attack, attack, attack!
It's called the Honeycomber! An upgraded version of the Bowgun called the Flechette Gun!
You really are strong! Beating that giant dragon three times...
You must be really skilled.
I know! Here's a tip for you. I hear there's a skill called Rapid Fire.
They say it's a skill that lets you fire a Bowgun without reloading.
A hunter as skilled as you could surely give it a try.
I hear the Rapid Fire skill lets you fire a Bowgun without reloading. I'm sure you could give it a try.
It seems that in what they call top-rank quests, once in a great while, you get dropped into a special place.
You can find rare items in that special place. It's a bit of a rumor among hunters.
A special place you can reach, very rarely, in top-rank quests...
What kind of items do you think you can get there?
What's more, one combination of Bowgun ammo makes several shots, like 5 to 10.
If you want to be a top Gunner, you have to combine your own ammo!
Bowgun ammo, see... One combination makes several shots, like 5 to 10.
If you want to be a top Gunner, you have to combine your own ammo!
How about that? Combining is really simple, and really deep, isn't it?
Bowgun ammo, see... One combination makes several shots, like 5 to 10.
And by combining ammo, you can also make Flaming S, Water S and Thunder S. Amazing, huh!?
Bowgun ammo, see... One combination makes several shots, like 5 to 10.
And by combining ammo, you can also make Flaming S, Water S and Thunder S. Amazing, huh!?
Hey, I heard! You slew the Cephadrome in the desert. That's amazing!
But we're not slacking either. We just got in new armor called Silver Metal Boots!
Their Defense is second to none! Be sure to buy some! ...Now then, again.
Whoa! You slew Rathalos!? I'm really amazed!
Of course, we've got new armor in, too. Dark Metal Boots and Pink Metal Boots!
Both are strong leg gear for fighting wyverns. Pink is for women only, so I can't sell it to men! ...Now then, again.
Oh, wow! The hero who beat Monoblos is back! Well then, rob me blind!
I'll make a special deal on our secret top armor, Chrome Metal Coil and Chrome Metal Boots!
This is amazing armor you can only get here, so take good care of it! ...Now then, again.
I finally got a letter from my brother! He couldn't write because he was chasing bigger monsters.
It's in his letter: Familiar monsters aren't always the same size! Today's prey is a thrilling size! ...he says.
I don't care how big monsters are... What a pain my brother is.
I finally got a letter from my brother. It says monsters aren't all the same size! ...and so on.
I don't care how big monsters are... What a pain my brother is.
His letter says now he's after monsters even bigger than wyverns. Honestly! I give up.
If only the legendary hunter who vanished would show up... He'd use Herbs and Potions and slay those things.
You need healing items when you fight carnivores. Sigh, if only the legendary hunter who vanished were here...
They saw a poisonous bird wyvern near the Swamp!
The Village Chief says you'll need Antidotes to stand up to that monster.
Sigh... If only the legendary Gunner who vanished years ago were here.
If only the legendary hunter who vanished would show up, he'd use Antidotes and slay that poisonous monster...
But you know, I think giving her a rare fish you caught would work too.
I heard that once in a while, you can catch a fish that shines like gold...
If you're after golden fish, get a certain bait. You can make it by combining a Burrowing Bee and a Firefly.
Look at my buddy. All worked up over one letter.
Hm... What do you want? Oh, you again. Coming to me for info... Hunting's tough, huh?
Speaking of tough, getting Bowgun ammo costs a lot of money, too.
When that happens, make your ammo by combining. Using up one set of materials should get you several shots. Trust me and try it.
But how long do you plan to keep hunting? I'd quit before you get badly hurt.
If you want ammo cheaply, make your shots by combining.
Crag S, Clust S, Flaming, Water and Thunder S. Hm... How do I know so much?
Crag S, Clust S, Flaming, Water, Thunder S. You can combine special ammo, too.
The weapon shop sometimes gets new equipment. When you feel you've grown, go talk to them.
He'll even sell you rare items this village doesn't have.
And the trader sometimes comes to this village with newer items. When you feel you've grown, go talk to him.
The town trader and our weapon shop: talk to them when you feel you've grown.
Don't forget to take the materials you carve from monsters to the blacksmith.
The blacksmith uses those materials to Create equipment and Upgrade weapons for you.
I hear some of the gear you can put together in this village has really useful skills.
One is Razor Sharp. They say it doubles how well a melee weapon holds its Sharpness.
The other is Normal S Up. They say it raises the power of a Bowgun's Normal S.
You came at a good time. I just got new items in from the town.
You're starting to look like a real hunter. I just got new items in from the town.
I especially recommend the Cool Drink. It helps you stand the heat, a must in the desert or the volcano.
I heard you slew Monoblos. Amazing! Oh, speaking of amazing, I just got the best items in from the town.
And from the Storage Expert series, the Book of Power! Plus lots of useful tools! ...Now then, again.
Is it true you slew Rathalos!? All right, then I'll show you items as good as you are.
Perfect timing! I just got new items in from the town.
Today I recommend Storage Expert! The best item there is: your Item Box holds 100 more. This time it's the Book of Skill!
Have you ever heard of a place called the Training School?
Hm. So you beat Monoblos... I hate to say it, but as a hunter, you're better than me. ...I admit defeat.
It must have been a tough one. I ran into one once myself, and I still can't forget that horrible single horn...
What!? The one-horn you slew was sand-colored? I think the one I met was different... Am I mistaken?
The one-horn you slew and the one I met... Somehow our stories don't match...? Is it some mistake?
Press the R1 button to switch your attack style and press on with a storm of combos! But watch your Stamina while you do.
Though they say a disaster like no other is coming to this village... That huge shadow I saw in my dream... surely it was...
Oh, sorry! Old men do talk to themselves! Fine job slaying Monoblos, Hero of Kokoto!
So the villagers wouldn't panic, I had quietly made up my mind to stop it all by myself.
Lastly, I give you this blade, the most treasured of all my treasures! Well done, Hero of Kokoto!
Of course, you'll start from Hunter Rank 1 like everyone else. I'm looking forward to seeing how far you go!
The way out to quests is on the right side of this tavern. Don't get lost!
You've grown even more. You're just one step from the top-rank quests, only for the very best hunters.
We hunters gain experience and hone our gear to earn our daily bread. But in doing so, we have also opened up forbidden ground.
In top-rank quests, your foes are even stronger. Is there anyone who can stand up to them, and even beat them...?
You repelled Lao-Shan Lung's return and climbed this high! Well done!!
I recognize you as one of the very best hunters, and allow you to take on top-rank quests.
However! In the top-rank quests from here on, the Guild cannot promise you its full support. Listen well to what I explain now.
First, supplies. In the top rank, there's no guarantee we can deliver your supplies as before.
I'm expecting great things from you!!
Ho ho ho. I recognize you as one of the very best hunters, and allow you to take on top-rank quests.
However, in the top-rank quests from here on, the Guild cannot promise you its full support.
Always face them ready to risk your life. I'm expecting great things from you!!
Driving off Lao-Shan Lung again and again...
Hoo hoo! It seems you've slain at least 20 of every wyvern.
Heh heh heh. Today is the market's half-price sale. I'll take combination requests at half price.
Heh heh heh! Could it be you've succeeded at every combination?
I'm surprised you know so much. Perhaps I should entrust you with this book.
The secret of the Book of Combos series: Book of Combos G: Alchemy. Even deeper combining that makes something from nothing awaits you. Use it with care.
By freely combining the parts of your armor, you can gain special abilities called Skills.
Head, body, arms, waist, legs: the points of one skill type on each part add up, and the skill activates.
You can always check your Skills on the Status screen. *Mumble*...
By freely combining the parts of your armor, you can gain special abilities called Skills.
Head, body, arms, waist, legs: the points of one skill type on each part add up, and the skill activates.
Buy Monster Info, and you can record how many monsters you've slain and their size, too. *Mumble mumble*...
By freely combining the parts of your armor, you can gain special abilities called Skills.
Head, body, arms, waist, legs: the points of one skill type on each part add up, and the skill activates.
You can always check your Skills on the Status screen. *Mumble*...
Head, body, arms, waist, legs: the skill points of the same skill type in each armor part are added up to activate Skills.
You can always check your Skills on the Status screen. *Mumble*...
Hm? This is the materials shop. The hunters have done well, so I have finer materials than usual. Take a look.
Hm? This is the materials shop. Seems today is half-price day, so I've made my shop half-price too.
How to get Melynx Tools? That's a secret, gob!
I won't tell you it's a Catburglar, a Pawprint Stamp, a Platinum Ticket, and my favorite secret ingredient, gob!
Today, as a special treat, let me tell you about an extremely rare stone you seldom see.
Today, as a special treat, I'll tell you about an extremely rare material you seldom see.
I feel like a big dragon is coming, meow! How do I know? Don't underestimate a Felyne's nose, meow!
Do you know this, meow? If you climb onto a giant dragon's back and press the ~B00 button, you can carve materials, meow. Did you know, meow?
Climb onto a giant dragon's back and press the ~B00 button to carve materials, meow. Try it next time, meow.
In every room but the Pawn Room, you get a ticket at your 10th, 20th, 30th, 40th, 50th, 75th and 100th stay, meow.
After 100 you don't get any, but you might get one by joining a certain event, meow. Got it, meow?
Paid rooms stop giving tickets after 100 stays, meow. But you might get one by joining a certain event, meow.

stick in a set pattern for ~C05combo attacks~C00.

boost of the mode change, and the dazzling
sword moves it unleashes.

column1: # --- Training School briefings (sub_main, the instructor; 3 lines, wide box)

column4: Brutal attack power and a body as tough as steel: it's\n~C05Monoblos~C00! A wyvern as mighty as I am!!\nGet your hands on ~C05Sonic Bombs~C00 and you'll stand a chance!
Your final trial is ~C05Gravios~C00! The battle is in the volcano,\nwhere your Health drains fast. Start by finding\n~C05Cool Drinks~C00, and when the fight heats up, use bombs!
In these hunts, ~C05how you use your few items is key~C00.\nGather, combine, and slay Yian Kut-Ku without armor!\nYou can do it! ...Probably.
In Training School, monsters give very different carves!\nVelociprey give ~C05Throwing Knives~C00, for example! Why knives\nfrom Velociprey? ~C05If you have to ask, you've already lost~C00!
~C05The Hammer packs huge power~C00. Go for broke right away,\nor take time to prepare your items?\nJudgment is a vital quality for a hunter, too!
Lured by your tasty scent, a ~C05Velocidrome~C00 has come too,\nbesides the Yian Kut-Ku! ~C05Combine Power Extract~C00 from\nMosswine, and let them have a Lance charge!
With a Bowgun, it's ~C05a battle against your ammo count~C00!\nRestock ammo by combining and use bombs and other items.\nWhatever you do, don't run out of shots!!
The problem is ~C05how to drag it up out of the ground~C00!\nSearch the desert for Sonic Bombs, or, if you trust your\nsword alone, that works too. Go show it what you've got!!
Gypceros makes its own flash, so of course ~C05Flash Bombs\nwon't work~C00 on it! The ones in your pouch are to keep the\nVelociprey off you. Practice, and get a feel for ~C05distance~C00!
Gypceros' rubbery hide makes it a pain for a Hammer.\nBut ~C05its head~C00 is ~C05easier to damage~C00!\nPound it with your strongest charged attacks!!
This time I'll even let the Sword wear armor. Add ~C05Monster\nBroth~C00 from insects to a Barrel-Bomb to make ~C05a stronger\nbomb~C00! Blowing yourself up hurts, so be careful!
Just hitting a flying Rathalos with a Paintball is hard.\nBut this time I've given you a ~C05Psychoserum~C00! Get ready,\nfind it fast, and finish the fight in one go!
I just took a walk in the Forest and Hills and saw a big\n~C05Velocidrome~C00. But of course, that won't make me cancel\ntraining. Now, show me your hunter's guts!!
A Lance's ~C05charge loses its power~C00 fast when its\n~C05Sharpness drops~C00. Use a Whetstone to keep it sharp!\nThis time I've even hidden Whetstones near the camp!
I've prepared a special Bowgun that can ~C05fire almost every\nkind of ammo~C00! Use all your power as a Gunner and take on\n~C05the King of Wyverns~C00! Good luck!
Get used to ~C05Dual Swords~C00, a Sword variant, too! They can't\nguard, but they can use ~C05a big move called Demonize~C00.\nAlways keep an eye on your remaining Stamina!
Dodge Basarios' poison attacks by reading its moves!\nThe three ~C05Herbal Medicines~C00 in your pouch show how kind I\nam. ~C05Thank me until your tears run dry~C00! ...Nuhahahaha!!
Mix ~C05Ice Crystal~C00 with ~C05a certain insect~C00 to combine a\n~C05Cool Drink~C00! When you head for the lava, use it against\nthe heat so you don't waste Health!
To a Gunner who keeps away and ~C05calmly reads its moves~C00,\nBasarios is nothing to fear! The enemy to watch out for\nmost is yourself. ~C05Don't let your guard down~C00!!
~C05Throwing Knives~C00 are handy for giving a huge wyvern\n~C05status effects~C00 like paralysis or poison! Hit it from its\nblind spot, and when it stops, land a heavy blow!
~C05Mastering the guard~C00 is the first step to becoming a\nLance master! Guarding long tail attacks takes a bit of\n~C05knack~C00. Practice until you can block them perfectly!
Just as you look through the scope to judge the wyvern...\n~C05a Bullfango charges in from the side~C00!! ~C05Grrr~C00!\nTaking out the small monsters first is one way to go!
As you know, ~C05Plesioth's attack is tremendous~C00! Facing\nit without armor is how a hunter proves their strength!!\nWhat, that's crazy? ...You think so too?
The weapon I, ~C05a man of taste~C00, chose this time is the\n~C05Rathalos Firesword~C00! Fire works on Plesioth!! If you lose\nwith this, start over from scratch! Go and nail it!
~C05Crag S~C00 bursts as ~C05loud as a Sonic Bomb~C00! Everyone knows\nPlesioth hates noise. Use that, and you may be able to\ndrive it out of the water!
Surprised? ~C05This time your Sword comes with armor~C00!\nAnd I chose earrings suited to an item-focused fight!\nVictory is yours!!
~C05Its natural enemy appears~C00! If its roar freezes your\nlegs, its next charge will surely send you flying. I'd say\nhang in there, but if you can't, ~C05mind where you stand~C00!
Seems some ~C05Felynes~C00 with bombs are frolicking around. Lure\nthose cute creatures in, ~C05harden your heart, and send them\ncharging at the wyvern~C00! Ugh... Don't you cry now!
When you fight somewhere cold, like a cave, you'll want a\nwarm drink! Combine ~C05Hot Pepper~C00 and a ~C05Worm~C00 to make\na ~C05Hot Drink~C00 that warms you to the core!
A nimble Sword user should make use of the ~C05exploding\nrocks~C00 around! Memorize where they are and ~C05lure your foe\nwell~C00! This is the last stretch. Finish it off!
What, the ~C05Cool Drinks~C00 I put in your pouch are gone!?\n...Q-quiet! Find some yourself! Ugh, I ~C05drank too many\ncold ones~C00 and my stomach...
Even tough Gravios can't stop a Hammer! Watch out\nfor its full-body ~C05pressing attack~C00 and the ~C05scorching\ngas~C00 it blows from its whole body!
This time, a present: gear with the ~C05Anti-Heat~C00 skill!\nWith this, you can fight hard right next to the lava!\nHmph, I've gone soft...
This time: ~C05earrings so you won't need to reload~C00.\nYou can fire nonstop, but ~C05the recoil gets bigger~C00!\nDon't get carried away. Fight with care!!
